author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Open grooming scissors mirrored about the 45-degree axis: two finger rings with shanks meeting at the pivot and two broad curved leaf blades opening up and right, as in the reference; the blades now have real width and curved backs instead of two thin prongs.
omissions: Finger rings are r5 (the reference's are larger) so the curved blade backs keep 8 units from them; the blades meet at the pivot instead of crossing past it.
